BindingSource.description: explicit rows are written by bind, unbind, or the session-end tail and are authoritative. inferred rows are derived from store observations, never override an explicit binding, and are absent when the derivation is ambiguous.

Confidence.description: How strongly the binding claims to be true, using the lifecycle confidence vocabulary. Explicit bindings are verified. An inferred binding is observed unless the store recorded a stronger derivation; the claim-ownership rule is observed, because it correlates a session claim with active ownership rather than a command that recorded this session's intent.

enabled.description: Whether the operator enabled Peasant project enrichment. Disabled is the default and is distinct from unavailable.

message.description: Actionable detail for disabled or unavailable; empty when the source is ok.

source.description: Which opt-in backend is configured: none when disabled, db for --peasant-db, api for --peasant-url.

status.description: disabled when the integration is off; ok after the configured source has answered a lookup successfully; unavailable when it has not been contacted yet or could not be opened, reached, or read.

enabled.description: Turn the runtime Peasant project-enrichment switch on (true) or off (false).

expectedBinding.description: Only change the mapping when this binding ID is still active.

role.description: Role recorded for the project in this epoch. Omit for worker.
The role the operator recorded for the project in this epoch.

ProjectBindingSource.description: Project mapping provenance. A project mapping is an explicit operator relation; it is never inferred from a working directory or a session binding.

items.description: Projects with an active mapping. A project whose mappings are all closed is omitted.

expectedBinding.description: Only close the mapping when this binding ID is still active.

intervals.description: Full mapping history ordered by boundAt ascending. Present on detail responses; omitted from list rows.

projectHash.description: Peasant-owned project identity, preserved exactly. Pasture never derives or recomputes it.

role.description: The protocol session role the bind recorded (epoch, architect, reviewer, supervisor, or worker).

For an explicit interval, the protocol session role a bind command recorded. For an inferred interval, the assignment slot the derivation read (currently owner-responsibility), because no command gave the session a role; clients must not read an inferred role as a protocol session role.

bindings.description: Every known binding interval for the session, ordered by boundAt ascending and then bindingId. `binding` is the effective current binding: the latest explicit binding when one exists, otherwise the open inferred derivation.

project.description: Peasant-owned project display label for the session. The label depends on the configured source: with --peasant-db it is the canonical remote label when the remote is recognizable, else the canonical cwd, else the project hash; with --peasant-url it is Peasant's resolved project label. Present only when the operator enabled project enrichment and Peasant mapped this session; absent otherwise. Pasture never derives it.

projectHash.description: Peasant-owned opaque project hash for the session, preserved exactly. Present only when the operator enabled project enrichment and Peasant mapped this session; absent otherwise. Pasture never recomputes it.

TranscriptPayload.description: The durable Peasant SessionDetailPayload document, proxied unchanged. Pasture guarantees only the identity fields; every other field belongs to the shared @peasant-labs/schema session contract and is validated by the browser.

items.description: One Peasant TurnDetail; validated by the browser against the shared contract

info.description: Loopback-only session and epoch API for active harness sessions mapped to epoch bindings. It also records explicit project-to-epoch mappings: a project hash is Peasant-owned, the mapped epoch is a Pasture task, and the relationship is independent of per-session bindings. The transcript route proxies one durable Peasant SessionDetailPayload; Pasture does not reshape transcript content.

get.description: Validates the harness and native session id against the shared @peasant-labs/schema contract, runs `peasant export sessions --session <nativeSessionId>` beside the API in a private temporary directory, and streams the durable SessionDetailPayload document unchanged. The route never returns a last-good transcript when Peasant refuses a newer incomplete attempt. The browser validates the body against the same shared contract before rendering it.
